column1: # Hand-curated for Spanish: chat abbreviations, laughter, internet words and
# loanwords as people type them — so autocorrect leaves them alone and suggests
# them. `word<TAB>count`; counts are moderate made-up frequencies on the scale of
# the subtitle counts (bueno ≈ 1 000 000). Only words the sources lack or
# undercount; a word already in the lexicon keeps the larger count.
